name: shifting-dropdown
title: Shifting Dropdown
description: A compact top navigation where hovering or clicking a tab opens a wide dropdown panel beneath it. The panel stays open while you move between tabs, sliding new content in sideways, and a small pointer follows the active tab.
use: A marketing header has few top-level links but each needs a rich panel of sub-links, categories or posts.
avoid: It needs hover and a wide fixed panel, so narrow screens overflow and touch users cannot preview items.
a11y: Tabs are real buttons, but they lack aria-expanded and there is no Escape or arrow-key handling, so the panel is awkward from the keyboard. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three short grey tab labels with tiny chevrons sit in a row on near-black. The active tab gains a dark rounded pill and an upturned chevron, and a wide bordered panel drops beneath with columns of links, or icon cells, and a small diamond nub pointing up.
behaves: Hovering a tab opens the panel below with a fade and lift. Moving to another tab keeps the panel open while the new section slides in from the side and the nub glides under the chosen tab; leaving the row closes it.
customise: Tabs, their titles and panel contents are hardcoded arrays and components in the file; there are no props, so adding a tab or link means editing the source.
weight: light: Three buttons and one small panel; animation only runs while a menu is open.
